subject: Multilevel CFA Lavaan: Partially saturated model and its corresponding null model

messages.author: 2d82bba8acffc105
messages.subject: Multilevel CFA Lavaan: Partially saturated model and its corresponding null model
parts:
Dear all,

I'd like to run a saturated between hypothesized within multilevel CFA-Model and define the baseline model following Ryu & West's (2009) recommendation (https://doi.org/10.1080/10705510903203466).  Unfortunately, neither my model nor the null model converges for none of my 9 scales. My n might be underpowered (167 individuals nested in 37 clusters). Still I wanted to make sure, that I didn't just misspecified the models. So I would very much appreciate if someone could take a second (more professional) look. In addition, if you have any recommendations as to how I could "make" the models converge I would be very thankfull as I am new to R and new to SEM. All I tried so far was changing the estimator (ML) to a robust one (MLR), which did not change a thing.

As far as I know my model should look like this:
sat.between <- 'level: 1

  f =~ NA* x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 + x6

  f ~~ 1*f

 

  level: 2

   x1 ~~  x1 +  x2 +  x3 +  x4 +  x5 +  x6

   x2 ~~  x2 +  x3 +  x4 +  x5 +  x6

   x3 ~~  x3 +  x4 +  x5 +  x6

   x4 ~~  x4 +  x5 +  x6

   x5 ~~  x5 +  x6

   x6 ~~  x6 

'



I am interested in the L1 Model only. So the baseline model should be saturated at L2 and independent at L1. Following a prior post on null models in Lavaan I understand the traditional null model looks like this: 

traditional.null <- ' level: 1
x1 ~~ x1
x2 ~~ x2
x3 ~~ x3
x4 ~~ x4
x5 ~~ x5
x6 ~~ x6

level: 2
x1 ~~ x1
x2 ~~ x2
x3 ~~ x3
x4 ~~ x4
x5 ~~ x5
x6 ~~ x6
'
where x1 to x6 all represent indicators/my items.

Adopting the model to Ryu and West's (2009) recommendations,
the model I created looks like this:

rw_null <- ' level: 1
x1 ~~ x1
x2 ~~ x2
x3 ~~ x3
x4 ~~ x4
x5 ~~ x5
x6 ~~ x6

level: 2
x1 ~~ x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 + x6
x2 ~~ x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 + x6
x3 ~~ x3 + x4 + x5 + x6
x4 ~~ x4 + x5 + x6
x5 ~~ x5 + x6
x6 ~~ x6
'
I fit both models (sat.between and rw_null) via the lavaan function as following:
  • lavaan(model, data, cluster, auto.var = TRUE )
and get the warning that the optimizer does not find any solution (regardless of robust or default ML).

I am grateful for any advice,

Kind regards,
Anna

PS: I also get the warning message that there are clusters with no within variances - but I think they are not (too) problematic.

PPS: I also tried a null model in which I explicitly restricted noncovariance between all L1 indicators by adding
x1 ~~ 0*x2
x1 ~~ 0*x3
x1 ~~ 0*x4
x1 ~~ 0*x5
x1 ~~ 0*x6
x2 ~~ 0*x3
x2 ~~ 0*x4
x2 ~~ 0*x5
x2 ~~ 0*x6
x3 ~~ 0*x4
x3 ~~ 0*x5
x3 ~~ 0*x6
x4 ~~ 0*x5
x4 ~~ 0*x6
x5 ~~ 0*x6

to the level: 1 code of my null modell (rw_null). This did not help either.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Multilevel CFA Lavaan: Partially saturated model and its corresponding null model
parts:
Without seeing the data, the only thing I can say is to try a different
optimizer. Try adding the arguments

optim.method = "em"

and

verbose = TRUE

If this takes forever, it is likely that some between variances are
close to zero.

If you are able to send me the data, I can have a closer look.

Yves.
